topic: How to Clean a Bathroom Exhaust Fan
notes: Electrical safety comes first. Tell readers to turn off power before cleaning or servicing and keep the guide limited to accessible grille/housing dust removal unless the specific fan manual permits more. Do not advise motor disassembly, lubrication or electrical repair. If wiring, motor noise, damage or unsafe access is involved, recommend qualified service.
